findings.title: Optimized paginator cannot key or filter datetime audit rows
findings.body: When optimized_pagination=true, the audit-log endpoint paginates AuditLogEntry with order_by="-datetime" using OptimizedCursorPaginator. That class's get_item_key does math.floor/math.ceil on getattr(item, self.key), and value_from_cursor returns the raw cursor number. A datetime cannot be floored, and a numeric cursor value is compared in SQL against the datetime column. Any non-empty optimized page raises TypeError while building the cursor; a follow-up request with a cursor either 500s or filters the wrong rows. DateTimePaginator (still used on the other branch) is the implementation that encodes and decodes this field. There are no tests covering the new branch.

findings.title: Negative cursor offsets are sliced into the queryset
findings.body: OptimizedCursorPaginator.get_result, when enable_advanced_features is set and cursor.offset < 0, does queryset[start_offset:stop] with a negative start. Django QuerySet slicing rejects negative indexes (ValueError: Negative indexing is not supported), so the audit-log path that passes enable_advanced_features=True returns 500 for any client-supplied cursor whose offset is negative (Cursor.from_string already accepts that). The same unclamped prev-cursor offset is also applied in BasePaginator.get_result for every endpoint using that paginator. This does not skip the organization filter, but it does turn a crafted cursor into an unhandled error instead of a bounded page, and it does not implement the claimed reverse scan.

findings.title: No tests for OptimizedCursorPaginator or the audit-log switch
findings.body: OptimizedCursorPaginator and the organization audit-log branch that selects it (optimized_pagination plus superuser/global access) ship with no tests. A test that returns at least one AuditLogEntry through that paginator would fail immediately on datetime key extraction, and a cursor with a negative offset would show the queryset slice error. Without that coverage the broken path can merge while the default DateTimePaginator path still looks fine.
